description: Add tests for all untested client portal pages (food-check-in, onboarding, change-password, faq)
steps: Step 1: Create new test file tests/e2e/client-pages-extended.spec.ts for untested client pages:
/client/food-check-in?demo=true:
- Page heading 'Daily Check-in' visible
- Running macro summary visible (shows cal, protein, carbs, fat)
- Weight input field present with placeholder 'e.g. 72.5'
- Meal slots render (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner sections from demo data)
- Dish options are pre-selected in demo mode (first option per component)
- Submit button present (may be disabled in demo mode)
- Demo dishes visible: 'Overnight Oats', 'Smoothie', 'Chicken Breast 150g', 'Palak Paneer 60g', 'Mixed Salad'
/client/onboarding?demo=true:
- NOTE: onboarding page does NOT check for demo mode - it requires auth (useAuth). When accessed with demo=true but no real user, it may show loading or require user. Test what actually renders:
- If the page renders: heading 'Let's Get to Know You' visible, step indicator 'Step 1 of 7: Profile', progress bar (7 segments), name/age/height/city/weight fields on step 0
- If page requires auth and shows spinner/blank: just verify layout renders (header with brand name from client layout)
/client/change-password?demo=true:
- NOTE: This page requires auth (useAuth) and shows spinner if no user. When accessed with demo=true:
- If renders: heading 'Set Your Password', New Password and Confirm Password inputs, Set Password button
- If requires auth: verify the page at least loads without crashing (client layout header visible)
/client/faq?demo=true:
- Heading 'Video Tutorials' visible
- Subtitle 'Watch helpful guides about diet, nutrition, and fat loss' visible
- Video tutorial cards render with titles: 'How Fat Loss Actually Works', 'Can I Have a Cheat Meal?', 'How Many Calories Should I Eat?', etc.
- Each video card has a Video icon (from lucide)
- Google Drive iframe elements present (src contains drive.google.com)
- At least 10 video tutorials rendered (check count of video cards)
acceptance_criteria: All new tests pass when running npx playwright test
Each untested client page has at least 3-5 meaningful assertions
Tests are resilient to auth-required pages (use conditional checks or verify page doesn't crash)
Food check-in page tests verify demo data rendering correctly
verification: Run npx playwright test and confirm all tests pass
Run npm run build and confirm build succeeds
